logo.prompt: Precise asset extraction from approved design board. Isolate ONLY this exact existing icon: The LARGE HERO LOGO at upper left: blue-violet rounded square with ivory folded-ribbon capital N. Preserve its exact silhouette, folds and color. Preserve the approved artwork faithfully, do not redesign or add detail. Deliver ONE production app icon, front facing, square 1:1 image, icon outer rounded square occupying 94 percent of image width and height, exactly centered with symmetric very narrow TRANSPARENT outer margin. Keep the subtle matte dimensional surface and edge lighting of the reference. Smooth clean edges suitable for downsampling to 32 and 16px. Do not include a checkerboard drawing or a white rectangle. This is a standalone bitmap asset, not a presentation board.
